chunks: about a man who buys straw from a threshing floor, each kurr for a specified thing, and takes possession of the straw, then sells it before the food is measured.
So he said: "There is no harm."

key_terms.الطَّعَامَ: the grain or food being measured
key_terms.بَيْدَرٍ: a threshing floor or harvested pile from which the straw is bought
key_terms.تِبْنَ: straw being sold in the transaction
key_terms.كُرٍّ: a load or measured quantity used in the sale
key_terms.مَعْلُومٍ: specified and known in amount or value
key_terms.يَقْبِضُ: takes possession of the purchased item

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sell purchased straw before the grain has been measured?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on a sale involving straw purchased by a known amount and price. It indicates that once the straw has been taken into possession, selling it before the grain is measured is permissible. The report relates to commercial transactions and lawful dealing in sales.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Jamil asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who buys straw from a threshing floor, each load (kurr) for a specified price, and takes possession of the straw but sells it before measuring the grain.
Imam (as) said: "There is no harm in that."
